name: Sawatte! Trouble Click!! ~Haruna to Yui no Kiki~
original_name: さわって!とらぶるクリック!! ～春菜と唯の危機～
source:
Kidnapped, the two girls find themselves in a dark warehouse.
And scary creatures from outer space are standing before them..

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045490.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩被绑架，发现自己身处一个黑暗的仓库里。
来自外太空的可怕生物就站在他们面前。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045490.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
